g.text: Fixed head edits and explicit value inclusion in generated text
1,024 new content combinations; greedy generation, at most 16 tokens; paired 95% normal intervals.
Gray ×: 2 norm-matched controls per channel. Omitted attributes can leave a fact-compatible answer.
